integrity: Proof is self-contained; a standard-library checker exhaustively independently tests small n, not infinity. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only pairs of idempotents of the classical Catalan monoid are counted. The centralizer transfer counts only commuting idempotents, not all commuting monoid elements. Literature priority can be revised if an earlier equivalent enumeration is located.
title: Commuting idempotents of Catalan monoids: a gap criterion, centralizer transfer, and exact density
